description: Land Title Settlement Department - Kohuwala, Dehiwala D/S Division, Colombo District - Cad. Map No. 520801 and other land settlements
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains detailed declarations of land ownership determinations for specific parcels, including parcel numbers, owner details, extent of land, title classifications, and encumbrances. The content appears in "PART III - LANDS" of the gazette and focuses entirely on land registration and property ownership matters, fitting perfectly within the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4).
